_faq.q: What does the Winter Package include?
_faq.a: Two nights in a comfortable room, an extensive breakfast both mornings, a three-course dinner in our restaurant on the evening you arrive, a welcome drink (a glass of house wine or speciality beer), bathrobe and slippers and the wellness area during your stay. Early check-in from 12.00 and late check-out until 14.00 are subject to availability. Parking is free.

You can arrive from 1 December 2026 to 31 March 2027. From 1 to 23 December you can arrive Sunday to Thursday. The package cannot be booked from 24 December to 2 January, on 19 and 20 March or from 26 to 29 March.

_faq.q: Can I also have dinner on the second evening?
_faq.a: Yes, you can. Just let us know when you book and we will make sure you have a lovely table.

_faq.q: What is in the wellness area and when is it open?
_faq.a: The wellness area on the Top Floor covers more than 300 m², with four saunas (infrared, forest, salt stone and walnut), a steam cabin, experience showers, a plunge and herbal bath, foot baths and a relaxation room. Open Monday to Thursday from 16.00 to 22.00 and Friday to Sunday from 12.00 to 22.00. Tuesday is swimwear day; on the other days the wellness area is swimwear-free. Your bathrobe and slippers are ready in your room.

_faq.q: Can I cancel free of charge?
_faq.a: You will see the cancellation conditions of the package when you book, before you confirm your reservation. Not sure? Just give reception a call.
